title: Comments and annotations odt 001
notes: real ODF comments: 4 inline office:annotation elements (office:name anno1..anno4, alternating dc:creator bot-a/bot-b, fixed dc:date 2026-01-01T00:00:00), each holding the annotation body as text:p and anchored inline between the runs of its claim paragraph (point annotation — no annotation-start/end, so only the four annotation elements exist). The normative office:annotation counter scans content.xml, so the manifest must read office:annotation=4. Reference text includes every annotation body string (all visible strings, annotation text included) — honest caveat: PDF export may omit comment bubbles unless the renderer is told to export annotations.
